lines.beaver_en: Did you go shopping yesterday? What did you buy?
lines.learner: 네, 어제 옷을 샀어요. 셔츠를 샀어요.
lines.en: Yes, I bought clothes yesterday. I bought a shirt.
lines.roman: ne, eoje oseul sasseoyo. syeocheureul sasseoyo.

lines.en: It's a white shirt. The fabric was really nice.
Yes, they're a bit long. But they're still pretty.

lines.beaver_en: Did you buy a bag too?
lines.en: Yes, I bought a bag too. It's a small bag.
Yes, a bit expensive. It was eighty dollars.

lines.beaver_en: Did you buy new glasses too?
lines.en: No, there were no pretty glasses.

lines.beaver_en: Then didn't you buy anything else?
lines.en: I bought a hat. I wore it yesterday.

lines.beaver_en: Did you buy sneakers too? How much were they?
lines.en: Yes, they were seventy dollars. I wore them right away.

lines.beaver_en: Want to meet this weekend and talk more?

lines.beaver: 좋아요! 새 옷 꼭 입고 와요.
lines.beaver_en: Great! Be sure to wear your new clothes.
lines.beaver_roman: joayo! sae ot kkok ipgo wayo.
lines.learner: 네, 모자도 쓰고 갈게요. 주말에 봐요!
lines.en: Okay, I'll wear the hat too. See you this weekend!
lines.roman: ne, mojado sseugo galgeyo. jumare bwayo!
